page.title: Step-by-step video
page.subtitle: Same pipeline as the Agent, but you press each step: sources → script → approval → voice → scenes & images → render. Every file lives in the project folder.

list.empty: No projects yet. Click "New project" to start.

lock.script: Write or import a script first.
lock.approval: Approve the script first (button at the bottom of the Script tab).

form.title: New video project
form.sourcesHint: One YouTube link per line (1–5). Two or three videos on the same topic work best.
form.voiceUnavailable: VOICEVOX is not running — default voice #{{id}} will be used
form.notesPlaceholder: e.g. aimed at people over 60 living alone, avoid medical topics…
form.invalidSources: Enter at least one YouTube link

detail.select: Pick a project on the left, or create a new one.
detail.storedAtHint: project folder {{id}} (the video appears here once rendered)
detail.openVideo: Open video in a new tab
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this project and every file it produced (transcripts, voice, images, video)?

source.title: Sources
source.desc: Download the Japanese transcripts of the source videos.

script.title: Script
script.desc: Remake it with ChatGPT/Gemini from the source transcripts, or write/paste your own. Review it, then approve at the bottom to unlock Voice and Scenes.

approval.title: Approve script
approval.desc: Decide whether the script is good enough to voice. Review the checklist, the measurements and the full text below, then approve.

checks.similarity: Wording is not copied from the sources
checks.notMeasured: (not measured: source transcripts are not loaded)
checks.channel: Does not repeat the channel's earlier videos
checks.channelDetail: (compared with {{count}} earlier videos: wording, title formula)
checks.noEarlier: (no earlier videos on this channel to compare with)
checks.length: Length is inside the allowed window

approval.readHint: Approving means you read and accept this version. If it is not right, go back to the Script tab and edit it.
approval.effect: Approving unlocks the Voice and Scenes tabs. Saving the script again afterwards cancels the approval (and the voice and images made) so it must be approved again.

voice.title: Voice
voice.desc: VOICEVOX reads each sentence; subtitles come from the real audio timing. If scene images already exist, their timing is re-matched to the new voice.
voice.unavailable: Cannot reach VOICEVOX ({{url}}). The page re-checks every 10 seconds.
voice.result: Voiced: {{duration}} ({{actual}} min), planned {{planned}} min, allowed {{min}}–{{max}} min.
voice.outside: outside the allowed window — shorten or extend the script and voice again

scenes.title: Scenes & images
scenes.desc: Split the script into scenes and draw images in the channel's visual style. No need to wait for the voice: without it, scenes are cut on estimated timing and re-timed automatically once the voice exists. Can take a long time.

timing.provisional: Scene timing is estimated from the script for now. Once the voice is made, scenes are re-timed to it automatically.
timing.voice: Scene timing matches the real voice.

scenes.redoConfirm: Redoing everything re-cuts the scenes and redraws all {{count}} images (current images are deleted). To fix a few scenes, use "Redraw" on each scene below. Continue?

video.title: Render video
video.desc: Combine images, voice and subtitles into a 1080p video. Needs both the voice and the scene images.

motion.title: Image → video
motion.desc: Optional: animate scene images into ~8 s clips with Google Flow (Veo), run in Chrome on the main profiles' Flow quota. Scenes with a clip play it in the video; the rest stay images with Ken Burns. Skip this step to build the video from images as before.

remake.title: Remake with ChatGPT / Gemini
remake.hint: Opens a sub Chrome profile and runs the "Remake script" prompt over the source transcripts. The LLM picks a length of 12–30 minutes. Edit the prompt on the Prompts page.
remake.imported: Remake result taken as the script

editor.title: Write / paste script
editor.hint: A "# Title" line, each chapter starting with "## 1. Chapter name", one sentence per line. You can paste a script written elsewhere (for example following the manual test guide).
editor.saveNote: Saving re-measures similarity and cancels any approval, voice and images already made.

summary.title: Measurements
summary.noSimilarity: No source transcripts yet, so similarity to the sources was not measured.
summary.freshness: Against {{count}} earlier videos of this channel
summary.warn: Some measurements fail. You can still approve, but fix them to avoid being treated as reused or templated content.

library.rootHint: Each project sits in its own folder named by the project id. Loose transcripts are in a folder per YouTube video id.

voicePreview.failed: Preview failed — check that VOICEVOX is running

scenes.title: Scenes ({{count}})
scenes.hint: Click an image to enlarge. "Redraw" uses the current prompt; "Edit prompt" to rewrite it first.

narration.title: Narration: {{chapters}} chapters · {{sentences}} sentences · {{duration}}
narration.hint: Click a sentence to hear just that sentence, or a chapter button to hear the whole chapter.
narration.misaligned: The voice no longer matches the current script (edited after narration) — timings are approximate; regenerate the voice.

channel.noStyle: no visual style — scenes cannot be made
channel.scenesConfirm: Existing scene images were drawn in the old channel's style. They are kept; regenerate scenes for the new style. Any rendered video must be rebuilt. Continue?

motion.channelImages: This channel is set to image-based video — pick intro or every scene to add motion.
motion.channelDefault: Default from the channel's video type: {{mode}}.
motion.summary: {{targets}} scenes selected, {{done}} already have a clip · project: {{clips}}/{{total}} scenes are video
motion.frozen: {{count}} scenes are longer than {{clip}}s: a clip lasts {{clip}}s, so the rest holds the last frame (~{{sec}}s in total). For all-video, use high scene density (short scenes) when making scenes.
